title: Joints: how we bend and move
examples: Teacher, what is the difference between a hinge joint and a ball-and-socket joint?
Can you show me an example of a pivot joint in the human body?
What is cartilage and where is it found in my body?

explain.say: Today we learn about joints which help us bend and move.

draw.text: Joints: how we bend and move
Joints: How We Bend and Move

explain.say: A hinge joint only allows movement back and forth like a door.
The shoulder uses a ball-and-socket joint for wide movement.
A pivot joint lets things twist around a single axis point.
Cartilage is smooth tissue that cushions the ends of bones.
When you twist your head you use a pivot joint.

faq.q: What is the difference between a hinge and a ball-and-socket joint?
faq.a: A hinge joint only moves in one plane, like opening a book. A ball-and-socket joint allows movement in many directions, like a shoulder.
asks: Which joint lets me bend my elbow?
What is the most flexible joint type?

faq.q: Where do I find a pivot joint in my body?
faq.a: You find a pivot joint in your neck, allowing you to turn your head side to side. It lets bones twist around each other.
asks: Where do I pivot my body?

faq.q: What is cartilage and what does it do?
faq.a: Cartilage is a smooth, white tissue found between the ends of bones. It acts like a cushion to reduce friction when you move your joints.
asks: Why do my knees sometimes hurt?
What protects my bones when I jump?

faq.q: Can I move my wrist like a ball-and-socket joint?
faq.a: No, your wrist is more like a hinge joint, allowing bending up and down. The ball-and-socket is best for the shoulder or hip.

faq.q: Which joint allows me to move my arm in a circle?
faq.a: The ball-and-socket joint at your shoulder allows you to move your arm in a wide circle. This gives you great range of motion.
asks: What joint lets me reach behind my back?
Which joint is for big movements?

facts: Hinge joints allow movement like opening and closing a door.
The shoulder is a ball-and-socket joint, giving great freedom.
Pivot joints allow twisting motion, such as turning your head.
Cartilage cushions the ends of bones to prevent rubbing.

quiz.say: The joint that allows you to turn your head from side to side is the:
quiz.why: The pivot joint is specifically designed for twisting motion around one spot.

wrong.0: Ball-and-socket joints are for wide, multi-directional movement.
wrong.1: Cartilage is a cushion, not a type of joint.
wrong.3: Hinge joints only allow straight back and forth bending.

quiz.say: If you are describing the movement of your hip, which joint type is best?
quiz.why: The hip joint is a classic example of a ball-and-socket joint for wide movement.

wrong.0: Hinge joints limit movement to a single plane.
wrong.1: Pivot joints only allow twisting, not bending in all directions.
wrong.2: Cartilage is the material, not the joint type itself.

quiz.say: What substance cushions the ends of bones at a joint?
quiz.why: Cartilage is the smooth tissue that prevents bones from grinding together.

wrong.1: Ligaments connect bone to bone, but cartilage cushions the ends.
wrong.2: Tendons connect muscles to bones, helping movement, but they do not cushion joints.
wrong.3: Bone is the hard structure; cartilage is the soft padding on it.
